debt.title: Two things are missing from this page
debt.body: The specification asks for the engagement length and a measurable outcome. The repository documents neither, and the publication consent does not cover the second. We do not invent them: their slots exist in the data, empty, and this page will show them as soon as a length is recorded and an outcome is publicly verifiable, sourced and cleared.
debt.footer: This panel disappears with the gap it names. That is what gives it an end.
